items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Well, he was playing in a band there with J.T. Watley.

ctx.x: Do you have any idea of what kind of training Professor Foster had?

No, I don't. I really don't. I don't know just what training he had because I understand that before that he was at the school before I was old enough to go to school. Then he went away. Then, he came back. Professor Watley, well, maybe you heard of him. J.T. Watley in Birmingham?
